records.pickupSummary: The times listed on our tours are the pickup and drop-off times. To ensure guests can arrive on time for their tour we require a 45 minute window between a ship's arrival time and a tour's pickup time. Likewise, we require 45 minutes between the drop-off time and the ship's departure to make sure guests will be back before their all-aboard time. If you are arriving on a ship or staying at a hotel in downtown Juneau, you will meet outside, under the cables of the Goldbelt Mt. Roberts Tram (490 S Franklin St) at your pick-up time. Find a Coastal Representative dressed in bright orange holding a yellow sign that reads 'Coastal Helicopters' to be checked in. If you are staying at a hotel near the airport, you will be met by a Coastal Representative outside the main doors of the lobby. records.cancellationSummary: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
records.pickupSummary:
*** This is an official product of Grupo Xcaret ***
1. For guests using Airbnb, a designated public meeting point has been allocated. Please write 'Plaza las Perlas' for Playa del Carmen on the address line. For Cancún, please write Base Xcaret. For Tulum, please write 'Aloft Tulum'. Please write 'Hotel Hacienda Morelos' when making a reservation for Puerto Morelos.
2. If your accommodation is not a hotel, you will need to enter your exact address including street name, street number, house number, county, postcode and city.
3. We can pick you up at your hotel or at the nearest available point on our routes.
4. To confirm your exact pick-up time and meeting point, please contact us at least 24 hours before your visit. From Monday to Friday, you may reach us through your reservation messages or by phone. On Saturdays and Sundays, our team is available by phone only to ensure a faster response and better assistance.
5. The guides will wear red T-shirts with the Xcaret logo on the back for easy identification. The guides will call out the name of the tour.
6. Upon pick up, please present your printed or digital voucher, photo ID and the credit card you used to make the purchase to board the bus and receive a wristband to enter the park.
7. You must arrive 15 minutes early at your assigned location.
Notes: 
a. Please let us know if you do not require transport.
b. We cannot guarantee to collect you from a hotel where you are not a guest, as some hotels have policies that do not allow visitors onto the premises.
c. If you do not have a hotel at the time you purchase your ticket, you must contact Viator Customer Service at least 24 hours prior to your park visit to coordinate your pickup with us.
d. Transportation is not private, so you will be sharing the bus with other visitors to Grupo Xcaret.
e. Depending on your hotel location, you should expect to spend between 30 minutes and an hour and a half travelling to the park.

One hour after your ship arrives, or as soon as you are able to disembark and reach the meeting point.

Our team will be waiting right outside the gate with a sign that says “2K’s Adventures Tours.”

Guests Staying on the Island
We offer pick-up and drop-off service for guests staying at hotels, resorts, or Airbnbs. Please provide the name of your accommodation, and your driver will be there to pick you up at your selected time.

Look directly for the C&C Scooter Rentals sign above our service window. Our port team will greet you and escort you to our private shuttle van for a quick 5-minute ride to our main vehicle compound to complete your check-in and safety tutorial briefing. We handle everything—including your guaranteed on-time shuttle return back to the port building at the end of your tour!

 • Pickup Location: Outside the Main lobby/valet entrance of your resort.

⏰ CRITICAL TIMING POLICY (HOTEL):
 • To keep our tours running on time, hotel pickups begin 45 to 60 minutes before your official tour start time.
 • We will message you your exact 10-minute pickup window the evening before your tour.

If you miss the shuttle because you were not in place, you will be responsible for getting to the tour activity starting point. There will be no refund!

 AIRBNB & PRIVATE RENTAL GUESTS:
 • Pickup Location: Directly at the front curb of your private Airbnb property.

 • ⚠️ IMPORTANT GPS INSTRUCTION: Please step completely outside and stand firmly in front of your Airbnb property on the main roadside while sending the location pin via WhatsApp. Do not send it from inside the house. This prevents the smartphone GPS network from glitching and accidentally sending our shuttle driver to a hidden backstreet or secondary lane.
